describe.description: The creature is a large, stout four-legged mammal standing in right-facing profile, covered in dense shaggy brown fur like a bear with a lighter tan muzzle. Its bear-like body is interspersed with glossy, dark reddish-brown hard structures resembling beetle wing-covers, with several smooth domed plates embedded in the fur of the neck, shoulder and side, and two large translucent membranous wings with dark brown veining protruding from the mid-body and lower chest. The flanks show rows of narrow dark slit openings in the fur, and the rear ends in a long segmented glossy tail tipped with a small forked claw.

describe.description: A stocky four-legged animal with dense shaggy brown fur standing in side view facing to the right. Its head, ears, legs and clawed feet are bear-like, while the torso has insect features: glossy dark reddish-brown beetle-like shell pieces on the shoulders, neck and side, two large translucent tan veined membranous wings extending outward from the sides of the body, two rows of narrow slit-like openings visible in the fur along the flank and hindquarter, and a long segmented glossy dark armored tail hanging from the rear ending in two small points.
